recording: 45-second master-bus and Windows WASAPI loopback recordings, no microphone; repeated diagnostic horns every 8 seconds while following the TGV from a copied save
cause: Audio consumed discrete physics poses before the camera update; the camera followed interpolated visual poses from another instant. Finite-difference velocities therefore disagreed despite following the same train.
fix: Keep visual interpolation; update the gameplay mixer at priority 200 after the camera (100), using current visual poses. Newly started horns inherit the engine emitter motion history.
validation: fixed master recording: no silent gaps over 1 ms, six origin shifts, zero discarded capture frames
limits: Quantitative pitch/velocity and silence analysis; no claim of listening to the recordings. This is an audio comparison, not a controlled rendering-performance benchmark.
